UserAccount.title: UserAccount
UserAccount.description: Minimal authenticated parent account record scoped strictly to Firebase Authentication UID.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID owning this account record.

displayName.description: Parent display name from Google Sign-In.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the account record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last account update.

/users/{userId}.description: Owner-only authenticated account records indexed by Firebase Auth UID.
